name: 威廉·劳伦斯·布拉格
bio_short: 澳大利亚裔英国物理学家。他在22岁时提出了“布拉格定律”，与父亲威廉·亨利·布拉格共同开创了X射线晶体学。他在25岁时获得诺贝尔物理学奖，至今仍是史上最年轻的物理学诺奖得主。
bio_short_en: an Australian-born British physicist. He formulated 'Bragg's Law' at age 22 and co-founded X-ray crystallography with his father, William Henry Bragg. He won the Nobel Prize in Physics at 25, remaining the youngest-ever laureate in Physics.
